<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 2"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Blade Brake](/Feats.aspx?ID=4778) <actions string="Reaction" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Fighter" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=601" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 141

**Trigger**
You would be moved by a forced movement effect

**Requirements**
You are wielding a melee weapon and are within reach of a hard surface

</column>

---

You plow your weapon into a floor, wall, or another sturdy surface, anchoring yourself in place. If you would be moved 20 feet or more, you are moved only 5 feet. Otherwise, you don’t move at all.
name: Blade Brake
requirement: You are wielding a melee weapon and are within reach of a hard surface
